name: figures/ai_arch_v2
prompt: Refine this academic architecture diagram (iteration 2). Keep clean CVPR/NeurIPS style: pure white background, flat vector, rounded rectangles, sans-serif Arial labels, thick dark-gray single-headed arrows with large filled arrowheads, muted blue/purple/green/orange color coding, no glow, no 3D, no watermark. CRITICAL: EVERY arrow must be SINGLE-HEADED (exactly one arrowhead). NO double-headed arrows anywhere. NO extra arrows. Layout = three vertical columns. LEFT column, gray group titled 'Frozen LLM Backbone', stacked top to bottom: box 'Input x_t'; a row of three small boxes 'Q', 'K', 'V'; box 'Attention'; box 'Output y_t'. Internal arrows: Input to Q, Input to K, Input to V; Q, K, V each to Attention; Attention to Output. MIDDLE column: one purple box drawn as an 8x8 grid, titled 'Online State S (8x8)', placed at middle height. RIGHT column, lavender group titled 'delta-mem', stacked top to bottom: blue box 'Memory Projections' sublabel 'q, k, v'; light-purple box 'Read' sublabel 'r = S q'; green box 'Low-Rank Steering' with two chips 'dq' and 'do'; orange box 'Gated Delta Write' sublabel 'erase then write'. EXACTLY these seven cross arrows, each single-headed: (1) from 'Input x_t' horizontally right to 'Memory Projections', arrowhead at Memory Projections, label 'hidden state'; (2) from 'Online State S' horizontally right to 'Read', arrowhead at Read, label 'read'; (3) from 'Read' vertically down to 'Low-Rank Steering', arrowhead at Steering, label 'r'; (4) from chip 'dq' horizontally left along a TOP lane above the middle column to box 'Q', arrowhead at Q, label '+ dq to query'; (5) from chip 'do' horizontally left along a BOTTOM lane below the middle column to box 'Output y_t', arrowhead at Output, label '+ do to output'; (6) from 'Memory Projections' vertically down along the right column to 'Gated Delta Write', arrowhead at Write, label 'k, v'; (7) from 'Gated Delta Write' diagonally up-left to 'Online State S', arrowhead at S, label 'update S'. Far right: narrow amber panel 'Writing Granularity' with three mini rows labeled 'TSW', 'SSW', 'MSW'.

name: figures/ai_granularity_v2
prompt: Refine this academic diagram (iteration 2). Keep the same clean CVPR style: white background, three horizontal panels, flat vector, thick dark single-headed arrows, blue token squares, purple state squares, green readout squares, sans-serif labels, no glow, no watermark. Panel 1 'Token-State Write (TSW)': four blue squares x1 x2 x3 x4 in a row; four vertical single-headed arrows, one from each x square down to its purple state square S1 S2 S3 S4; states chained left to right by horizontal arrows. Caption 'write at every token'. Panel 2 'Sequence-State Write (SSW)': tokens grouped in dashed rounded boxes [x1 x2], [x3], [x4 x5 x6]; exactly three vertical single-headed arrows labeled 'mean', one per group, down to purple states S1 S2 S3 chained left to right. Caption 'one write per message'. Panel 3 'Multi-State Write (MSW)': ONE blue square x_t at top; EXACTLY THREE single-headed arrows fanning down from x_t, one to each of three purple squares S(1), S(2), S(3) stacked vertically; each S(i) linked by a short horizontal single-headed arrow to a green square r(i); the three green squares each send one single-headed arrow into one white box labeled 'concat' at bottom right. NO other arrows, no arrows pointing to empty space. Caption 'parallel sub-states reduce interference'.
